propositions: Outbound status mutations on Data Center are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=...) instead of being routed through transitions, causing status changes to be silently rejected by Jira

The Cloud transport (acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue_by_name, but the Data Center transport (transport.py) does not perform this routing, leaving status in the fields dict
JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue must pop status from kwargs and call transition_issue_by_name to resolve the status name to the correct transition, matching the Cloud transport behavior
Illegal transitions should be non-fatal and observable as bridge alerts rather than causing silent failures or fatal errors
The status routing logic must be extracted to a separate transitions module and integrated into update_issue while preserving the existing assignee routing and other field edits in the same call
